candidates.change_summary: Change the ticket require check from equality to greater-or-equal, allowing larger msg.value and affecting pot updates.
Remove resetting pot to zero after a win so pot remains carrying over after transfers.
Transfer fee to player instead of bank, changing remaining pot after play when a win occurs.
Refund full pot to sender on loss (random == 1) by moving transfer into else branch and resetting pot differently.
Change the required ticket amount check from equality to allow any value (remove require), so callers can send different msg.value and pot updates differ.
Change the fee recipient from bank to msg.sender, altering transfers and observable balances after play.
Change the condition to random == 1 so winners occur on the opposite random outcome, altering when pot is paid out.
Subtract the fee from pot before transferring to winner (transfer FEE_AMOUNT from pot rather than separate bank transfer), changing state and transferred amounts.
Move pot = 0 above transfers so pot is cleared before payouts, affecting observed pot after play.
